sources.title: Solomon Islands Government: Culture Division (Ministry of Culture and Tourism)
sources.said: Supporting arts and cultural organisations or institutions in the promotion of national arts and cultural heritage. … Providing capacity building training to artists and associations registered under the office.

figures.finding: The division's page, read whole, names no fund or amount.
